verdict.rationale: Shopify ships a documented Universal Commerce Protocol and MCP servers letting AI agents search catalogs, build carts, and checkout using natural-language-driven agent interactions, and runtime probes confirm this works live (full MCP handshake, real catalog search, real cart creation) rather than just being a doc claim. missing for 10: no evidence of a full natural-language order placement completing end-to-end, and no independent (non-Shopify) review validating the agent UX quality.
